data.source: NOAA ICOADS 1-degree Enhanced (sst.mean), 1960-present — monthly means, ERDDAP dataset noaa_psl_3a7b_f45b_d09a on upwell.pfeg.noaa.gov
data.author: NOAA ICOADS / NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (public ERDDAP)
data.license: Public domain (US Government work; NOAA disclaimer: not intended for legal use)
data.note: Raw CSV retrieved from the exact ERDDAP query URL above via a plain GET from an alternate network path (build host could not open a TCP connection to upwell.pfeg.noaa.gov on 2026-11-20); time range fetched in per-year chunks of the same query. Processing identical to a direct `make data` run.
data.displayed: footer data line (rendered from meta.source) + this manifest

data.source: Natural Earth 50m Land (ne_50m_land), clipped to the Adriatic map box lon 11.5-20.5, lat 39.8-47.0
data.author: Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com)
data.note: 50m resolution chosen so the Adriatic islands render (110m was a blob); rings simplified with Douglas-Peucker (eps 0.002 deg) to keep the file small. Regenerate with `make coastline` (scripts/build_coastline.py, stdlib only); raw GeoJSON cached in cache/ (gitignored).

policy: Accepted data sources: public domain (NOAA ICOADS, NOAA OISST, Natural Earth) or CC-BY-4.0 (Copernicus Marine, only with attribution and registration). NC/ND banned.
Every data file shipped in site/data/ must have an entry here.
The site footer data line is rendered from meta.source and must always name the source actually in use.
A data file with no manifest entry is a build failure (make validate), not a warning.
